_note: A reusable bank of Photoshop/Firefly-generated abstract art for ai.whitespacedesign.ca body images. All generated 2026-09-13, license: generated (not stock/CC0), source: adobe-firefly-photoshop, at 1600x900. Pick one, move/copy it out to public/images/ai/<slug>.jpg, then wire it into the post per the blog-post-image skill (body markdown image + frontmatter image: field). Palette matches src/app/blog/blog.css: dark navy (#0a0c10) ground, periwinkle blue (#7c9cff) and mint green (#3ddc97) accents.

flow-split.theme: a path diverging — one direction fading, one growing brighter
flow-split.good_for: decision points, branching workflows, choosing between options

converging-particles.theme: thousands of particles swirling into one bright core
converging-particles.good_for: consolidation, gathering context, many inputs becoming one output

glass-barrier.theme: a vertical shaft of light interrupted by a translucent glass plane
glass-barrier.good_for: approval gates, checkpoints, a pause before something proceeds

root-network.theme: an organic web of branching glowing threads

floating-glass-panels.theme: translucent panels floating and overlapping in depth
floating-glass-panels.good_for: layered systems, staged pipelines, abstraction layers

crystalline-order.theme: chaos on one side resolving into a precise lattice on the other
crystalline-order.good_for: going from messy input to structured output, data extraction

aurora-pulse.theme: slow aurora waves with one steady pulse of light at center

comet-loop.theme: a single trail of light looping in an infinite orbit
comet-loop.good_for: repeating/scheduled workflows, automation loops, recurring tasks

seam-of-light.theme: two contrasting forms meeting along one luminous seam
seam-of-light.good_for: human+AI collaboration, handoffs, where two things meet

dawn-break.theme: a warm light burst breaking through fragmented dark shapes
dawn-break.good_for: breakthroughs, time savings, a new capability unlocking

digital-brain.good_for: posts about reasoning/intelligence directly — a fairly literal/common AI-blog image, use sparingly

fractal-mind.theme: an infinite fractal explosion radiating from a bright core
fractal-mind.good_for: scale, complexity, systems that branch out from one decision

data-storm.theme: a swirling vortex of light fragments pulled into a singularity
data-storm.good_for: data processing, information overload resolving into clarity

singularity-core.theme: a blinding core surrounded by orbiting rings of data
singularity-core.good_for: a central system with many dependent parts, orchestration

circuit-galaxy.theme: a spiral galaxy where stars are circuit nodes
circuit-galaxy.good_for: large interconnected systems, scale, network effects

shattering-matrix.theme: a wall of falling glyphs shattering into light fragments
shattering-matrix.good_for: breaking down a problem, parsing/processing raw input

neural-bloom.theme: a neural network blooming outward like a flower
neural-bloom.good_for: growth, a system maturing, learning/improvement over time
